svg.aria-label: repohelix helix: files threaded along a double-helix strand, radius encodes churn, colour encodes ownership concentration
svg.title: repohelix: repository helix (nebula fixture)
svg.desc: A double-helix strand of the nine busiest files from the synthetic nebula history. Node radius encodes churn; colour runs from teal (shared stewardship) to amber (single-owner / bus-factor risk). Metrics describe code activity, not people.
